description: Introduction and overview of the Su-35: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Su-35 is a twin-engine supermaneuverable fighter built by Sukhoi, entering service in 2008 as the ultimate Su-27 derivative. Thrust-vectoring engines, an Irbis-E radar, and reduced radar signature make it Russia's most capable operational fighter short of the Su-57. Over 140 have been built for Russia and China. Baseline facts: Supermaneuverable fighter; service from 2008; 140+ built by Sukhoi; top Russian operational fighter..
